headline: Sensex and Nifty trade lower amid rising crude oil prices, inflation worries, and Q2 earnings updates

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Rise in crude oil prices weighing on market sentiment
Inflation concerns impacting broad market performance
Losses in key stocks such as HDFC Bank, Titan Company, Shriram Finance, and Tata Motors
Firm global cues helping markets recover from intraday lows
whatHappening: Sensex saw a decline of over 400 points with Nifty trading near 25,100 to 25,200 levels
FACT reported an 86% jump in Q2 net profit while Gillette India recorded a 10% rise in profit
Dish TV reported a Q2 net loss of ₹295 crore, which surpassed its revenue of ₹292 crore
SpiceJet scheduled a board meeting on Nov. 18 to consider a fundraising proposal
summary:
Indian stock markets traded under pressure as inflation concerns and rising crude oil prices weighed on sentiment.
Indices witnessed partial recovery from intraday lows supported by firm global market cues.
Major quarterly earnings announcements and board meeting notices kept individual stocks like FACT, Dish TV, and SpiceJet in focus.
